GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well faced breeze 1 length off, improved turn, Straightened Up half off, battled on strong to the line just no match winner # found 1 better
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: intention to be further forward; settled on pace.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths 3-4 wide, Restrained and Eased back to last at the 700m, trailed 11 Lengths Two Wide turning, one-paced in straight. (Blinkers OFF AGAIN) # Wide early/plugged
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When racing wide in the early stages, was eased back to a position with cover at the rear of the field.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 2 Lengths joint Lead on fence, went clear and led 2 Lengths turning, Headed 220m and Lost Ground to the line. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. App. jockey stated it led and raced keenly early/middle stages, sprinted fairly on straightening before peaking on its run approaching 100m and weakening from there. Trainer agreed its early racing manners were detrimental to its finishing effort and advised he would removed the blinkers next start, hoping it would settle and sustain a finishing effort. Post-race vet exam did not reveal and abnormality.] # weak once headed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, apprentice stated that her mount led the event and raced keenly in the early and middle stages. App stated her mount sprinted fairly on straightening before peaking on its run approaching the 100m and weakening from this point. App stated her mount's racing manners in the early and middle stages were to the detriment of its finishing effort. Trainer agreed and advised he would remove the blinkers from the mare's gear at its next race start in the hope it will settle and sustain a finishing effort. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, worked up fom the inside barrier, trailed 2 Lengths rail turning, got rails run rounding turn, railed up to within a neck Straightening Up , bested at the 200m and couldn't go with the winner to the line. (Blinkers AGAIN) # winner too good
Jumped Well to lead .5 Lengths 600m Outside Leader .5 Lengths home turn 2nd Middle Of Track hit lead 300m weakened final 100m # on pace/tired late

Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 2nd on fence trailing 2.5 Lengths (good pace), maintained 2nd position to trail 4 Lengths turning, took ground off the leader early in Straight but failed to keep on over the last 200m # no real excuses
jumped out ok , Slight bump. Settled Down Inside , 3rd 3 Lengths @ 550m. Same Position Straightening Up . Gradually Gave Ground . $2.70 Winner Led All The Way # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped heavily, and unbalanced, on jumping.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to face breeze half off, held together turn, Straightened Up half off, took narrow lead passing 100m and kept on to the line holding margin # breeze/kept finding
Jumped Well sat handy 1 length off, eased 3 Wide turn, joined in Straightening Up , took over passing 200m, drew 1 length clear 100m and kept on strong to the line # had run/too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok faced breeze half off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up half off, took narrow lead approaching 100m, kept on strong but headed in the shadows # breeze/led @ 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was hampered when crowded.
